product_overview: DTMS is a multi-tenant delivery tracking and management platform for operational teams, tenants, and super admins. It supports authentication, dispatching, warehouse scans, customer support, public shipment tracking, and tenant communications.
core_goals: Log into the system and access the appropriate operational workspace
Monitor deliveries, drivers, complaints, and tenant activity from role-based dashboards
Manage tenants and users for multi-tenant operations
Assign drivers to shipments and track driver movement in real time
Perform warehouse scan and receipt workflows
Look up shipment status publicly and submit demo requests

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with username and password, with optional tenant selection and super admin auto-detection.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Select tenant when applicable -> Submit login form -> See the authenticated workspace
Navigate to /login -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See an invalid credentials message

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: View role-based operational summaries with statistics and charts, including date-based filtering.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View statistics cards -> View charts -> Adjust the date range -> See the dashboard update to the selected period

features.name: Tenant Management
features.description: Manage tenant records by reviewing, creating, editing, filtering, archiving, unarchiving, and deleting tenants.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenants -> View tenant list -> Filter tenants by status -> Create a new tenant -> Edit tenant details -> Archive or unarchive the tenant -> Delete the tenant after confirming the action
Navigate to /tenants -> View tenant list -> Filter tenants by status -> See the list update to match the selected status

features.name: User Management
features.description: Manage users within a tenant scope, including creating, editing roles, and deleting users.
user_flows: Navigate to /users -> View user list -> Create a new user -> Edit the user role -> Delete the user
Navigate to /users -> View user list -> Create a new user -> See the new user appear in the list

features.name: Driver Tracking
features.description: Monitor driver locations and status on a live GPS map.
user_flows: Navigate to /driver -> View driver locations on the map -> View driver status indicators -> Observe the current active drivers

features.name: Dispatch Center
features.description: Review unassigned shipments, assign drivers, and inspect dispatch history.
user_flows: Navigate to /dispatcher -> View unassigned shipments -> Assign a driver to a shipment -> View the dispatch history entry for that assignment
Navigate to /dispatcher -> View unassigned shipments -> Review the dispatch queue -> Observe existing dispatch history

features.name: Warehouse Operations
features.description: Scan barcodes, review scanned items, and confirm receipt for warehouse workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to /gudang -> Scan a barcode -> View the scanned item in the results list -> Confirm receipt
Navigate to /gudang -> Scan a barcode -> View the scanned item in the inventory list

features.name: Customer Service
features.description: Track customer complaints, create new complaints, and update complaint status.
user_flows: Navigate to /cs -> View complaint list -> Create a complaint -> Update the complaint status -> See the complaint reflected in the list
Navigate to /cs -> View complaint list -> Create a complaint -> See the new complaint appear in the list

features.name: Global Control Tower
features.description: Super admin monitoring workspace for tenant-wide driver activity, throttling controls, and system health.
user_flows: Navigate to /global-control-tower -> View the heatmap of active drivers -> View trend-based stats cards -> Review system health metrics
Navigate to /global-control-tower -> View tenant activity controls -> Set a rate limit for a tenant -> Block the tenant -> Unblock the tenant

features.name: Tenant Communication
features.description: Super admin messaging workspace for selecting tenants, reviewing message threads, sending messages, and sending credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /komunikasi -> Select a tenant -> View the message thread -> Type and send a message -> See the sent message in the thread
Navigate to /komunikasi -> Select a tenant -> Type and send credentials -> See the message appear in the conversation

features.name: Tenant Inbox
features.description: Tenant-side inbox for reading and replying to messages from super admin.
user_flows: Navigate to /pesan -> View the message list -> Open a message -> Read the message -> Reply to the message -> See the reply in the thread
Navigate to /pesan -> View the message list -> Read an unread message -> See the unread count decrease

features.name: Public Shipment Tracking
features.description: Public shipment lookup using a tracking number.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking -> Enter a tracking number -> View the tracking status

features.name: Demo Request
features.description: Public form for requesting a demo account by submitting company and contact details.
user_flows: Navigate to /demo-request -> Fill in company name -> Fill in contact information -> Submit the request -> See the request submitted confirmation

features.name: Public Pricing
features.description: Public page for reviewing available pricing tiers.
user_flows: Navigate to /pricing -> View pricing tiers

features.name: Public Features
features.description: Public page for reviewing product features.
user_flows: Navigate to /features -> View the feature list

known_limitations.issue: GPS tracking requires real device GPS data to show driver positions
known_limitations.impact: Map may appear empty without active GPS signals

known_limitations.issue: Some charts depend on sufficient data volume
known_limitations.impact: Charts may show no data for new tenants

known_limitations.issue: Webhook system requires external endpoint configuration
known_limitations.impact: Webhooks won't fire without configured endpoints
